import openpyxl, datetime
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
current = datetime.datetime(2020,12,1)
# find columns to delete among data columns (starting col 9)
to_delete = []
for c in range(9, ws.max_column+1):
    v = ws.cell(row=1,column=c).value
    if isinstance(v, datetime.datetime) and v < current:
        to_delete.append(c)
print('deleting cols', to_delete)
# delete from highest to lowest
for c in reversed(to_delete):
    ws.delete_cols(c,1)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved, new max_col', ws.max_column)
"
